faq.a: Nargiz is associated with the Persian form نَرْجِس, whose core sense is nargiz; narcissus (persian).

faq.q: What is the origin of Nargiz?
faq.a: Nargiz is associated with Persian. Nargiz is Persian نرگس (narges), meaning 'narcissus'. It is used as a female given name in Azerbaijan and Iran.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Nargiz can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nargiz should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Narges is a Persian word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Nargiz mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nargiz is rendered نرگس and carries the sense نرگس، نرگس کا پھول.

faq.q: What does Nargiz mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nargiz is rendered نرگس and carries the sense نرگس، نرگس.
A romanized syllable approximation is nar-giz. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nargiz?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nargiz, nargiz. Script forms are نرګس, نرگس, نَرْجِس, नर्गिस.

faq.q: Is Nargiz a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
